verses.5: But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews, that they could not cause them to cease, till the matter came to Darius: and then they returned answer by letter concerning this matter.
verses.6: The copy of the letter that Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shetharboznai, and his companions the Apharsachites, which were on this side the river, sent unto Darius the king:
verses.7: They sent a letter unto him, wherein was written thus; Unto Darius the king, all peace.
verses.8: Be it known unto the king, that we went into the province of Judea, to the house of the great God, which is builded with great stones, and timber is laid in the walls, and this work goeth fast on, and prospereth in their hands.
verses.9: Then asked we those elders, and said unto them thus, Who commanded you to build this house, and to make up these walls?
verses.10: We asked their names also, to certify thee, that we might write the names of the men that were the chief of them.
